name: average-swan
description: A four-key sampler pad with square chassis wells, inset 10px-radius keys, and a hard press-in shadow.
purpose: Recreates a compact hardware pad (minus, plus, record, play) with native buttons and local radii instead of the shared Button shape.
bestFor: product UI that needs a recessed square well
avoidFor: dense toolbars that cannot spare the 2x2 pad
